CARES PostgreSQL Round 3.2 — Dependency and Blocker Map (Consolidated)

Status: Proposed governance dependency/blocker analysis only; NOT IMPLEMENTED, NOT TESTED, NOT AN APPROVAL, NOT AN AUTHORIZATION.
Round: Round 3.2 — Owner Decision Consolidation and Governance Reconciliation (documentation/governance only).
Source baseline: governance/postgresql-round3-owner-decision-gate @ 7c58808157ab512c49abeed3efd0757b4c37824c.

1. Classification scheme (required)

Each dependency is classified as one of:

  • Owner decision resolved: owner decision fully resolved for the relevant scope (no material unresolved technical/policy detail remains for that dependency). Not claimed in this consolidation except where explicitly evidenced; none claimed here.
  • Principle approved, technical details deferred: owner-approved principles/bounded conditions exist (Round 3.2), but technical details, validations, or formal approvals remain unresolved.
  • Partially resolved: some elements resolved by explicit evidence/approval, others unresolved (must be specific).
  • Still blocked: dependency cannot be satisfied/proceeded for affected scope due to missing approval/decision/evidence/prerequisite.
  • Requires technical validation: resolution/feasibility/readiness depends on technical design review, testing, measurement, or security/operability validation evidence.
  • Requires separate owner authorization: progression/execution requires an explicit owner authorization record (distinct from principle approval/decision consolidation).

Rule: a technical blocker is not marked resolved merely because its governing principle was approved.

5. Consolidated conclusion

  • Owner decision resolved: none claimed as fully resolved for implementation-relevant technical scope.
  • Principle approved, technical details deferred: OD-001–OD-013 (bounded, principle-level) and ADR 0006 in principle with bounded exclusions.
  • Partially resolved: none claimed as a distinct formal partial-resolution record beyond the explicit bounded principle-approval state above.
  • Still blocked: all implementation increments absent explicit authorization and satisfied prerequisites; hard/critical blockers remain for I-06 final semantics, I-12, I-13, I-14 and relevant PDs (notably PD-005/PD-006 and evidence/governance-dependent items).
  • Requires technical validation: pervasive across OD/PD/I dependencies (identity/lifecycle/idempotency/outbox/dedup/counter/isolation/performance/lifecycle mechanisms and evidence).
  • Requires separate owner authorization: required for any implementation increment and for formal progression where separate records/approvals are mandated; no implementation authorized.

No technical blocker is marked resolved merely because its governing principle was approved.
